skills.name: mbse-systems-engineering
skills.short_description: Trace system behavior and test competing causes
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-systems-engineering to explain why this system misses its target. Check plausible causes against our observations and give me the check that would distinguish the remaining causes.

skills.name: mbse-system-concept
skills.short_description: Compare system concepts against feasibility limits
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-system-concept to compare ways to meet the outcome in this brief. Show which options meet the hard constraints and what evidence could change your recommendation.

skills.name: mbse-conops
skills.short_description: Define who operates, decides, and restores service
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-conops to draft how our team will run and support this system. Show who owns each handover and who can resume service after an outage with the staff and information available.

skills.name: mbse-operational-scenarios
skills.short_description: Trace normal, exception, and recovery paths
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-operational-scenarios to trace this operation from trigger to outcome. Walk through the interrupted case and show who can resume, under what condition, and where the path ends.

skills.name: mbse-requirements
skills.short_description: Trace stakeholder needs to verifiable requirements
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-requirements to turn these stakeholder notes into reviewable requirements. Link each one to its source and give the conditions and observation a tester would use to judge it.

skills.name: mbse-architecture
skills.short_description: Allocate behavior and check interfaces and budgets
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-architecture to allocate the functions in this brief. Trace the critical path through the proposed interfaces and show where timing, ownership, or a shared dependency could break it.

skills.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skills.short_description: Judge whether evidence supports an engineering claim
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-verification-evidence to decide whether this test record closes the requirement. Show the decision rule, the result for each tested condition, and which configurations the evidence covers.

skills.name: mbse-baseline-review
skills.short_description: Find change impacts and check prior evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-baseline-review to compare these two baseline revisions. Cite the affected requirements and interfaces, identify which test results still apply, and locate any evidence gaps that prevent approval.

skills.name: mbse-aerospace
skills.short_description: Check flight or mission claims against assurance evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-aerospace to review this safety claim. Trace the affected flight or mission phase through the allocated control and identify which assurance evidence applies to the configuration.

skills.name: mbse-defense
skills.short_description: Trace mission and sustainment decisions to program evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-defense to review this sustainment plan against the mission and contract baselines. Identify who owns each handover and which records support the readiness decision.

skills.name: mbse-automotive
skills.short_description: Trace vehicle responses to safety goals and evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-automotive to review this degraded vehicle response. Show what the driver can observe, when mitigation must occur, and which evidence applies to that operating situation.

skills.name: mbse-medical-device
skills.short_description: Trace device risks from intended use to evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-medical-device to review this device risk-control claim. Follow it from intended use through the clinical workflow and show which observations support the control in that setting.

skills.name: mbse-electronic-systems
skills.short_description: Check HW/SW interfaces and implementation evidence
skills.default_prompt: Use $mbse-electronic-systems to review this hardware/software interface. Check startup and timing assumptions at both ends and identify what the supplied implementation evidence actually exercises.
